operations.title: Four-site transcendentality is carried by marked anticanonical curves
operations.body: Entry 1156 is verified. A source-linear marked denominator cuts a line in the infinity P2; its pullback to the quartic double cover is anticanonical and has genus one. Hence the smooth four-site pure boundary remains Tate/E7, while each generic marked section contributes a rank-two elliptic relative residue. This is a clean H2 pattern: unchanged carrier, richer marked-relative coefficient object. I am proceeding to the incidence calculus of these elliptic marked curves.

authority_basis.summary: Continue cosmology research and communicate verified four-site marked-relative result to Nima.
